questions: Can global state be represented as a consistent causal cut?
Can cyclic computation run with partial logical time?

sources.title: Keeping CALM: When Distributed Consistency is Easy
sources.finding: monotonic logic characterizes consistent coordination-free distributed programs

sources.title: The Coordination Criterion
sources.finding: coordination-free implementation iff specification is monotone under history extension for the declared outcome order

sources.title: Distributed Snapshots: Determining Global States of a Distributed System
sources.finding: consistent global states can be captured over distributed execution without requiring one physical instantaneous global read

sources.title: Naiad: A Timely Dataflow System
sources.finding: cyclic incremental computation can use logical timestamps and lightweight coordination

sources.title: Coordination Avoidance in Database Systems
sources.finding: invariant confluence localizes when coordination is necessary for application invariants

sources.title: Blazes: Coordination Analysis for Distributed Programs

collision_result: Core monotonicity/coordination, causal-cut, dataflow and determination-provenance ingredients are known. Candidate novelty cannot exceed a project-specific novel-combination claim without stronger search and real matched benchmarks.
counterevidence: A strong causal event-sourcing/dependency baseline may reproduce most MCM benefits without a new cognitive architecture primitive.
